responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s generic state-machine framework used by API misuse checkers. It defines the abstract state_machine interface, immutable state objects, merge/purge/leak and inheritance hooks, custom_transition support for nonlocal graph effects, and the sm_context callback API through which checkers query symbolic state, record transitions, issue pending diagnostics, manage global checker state, and trigger custom exploded-graph transitions.
same_name_distinction: Defines the abstract checker-facing state-machine API—state_machine, state, custom_transition, and sm_context contracts—whereas sm.cc supplies their shared utility implementations and the runtime assembly of concrete checker instances.
